note: Bavli: [Bekhorot 24b:8](sefaria:Bekhorot.24b.8) (28 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Ḥananel”. Student of Rav; also Rav Ḥananel bar Pappa. Biblical (Jer 31:38). Not anywhere in the paper.

Bavli: [Avodah_Zarah 29a:14](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.29a.14) (20 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Malkiyu”. Two amoraim (Rav Malkiya / Rav Malkiyu, the Bavli itself distinguishes them). Biblical מלכיה/מלכיהו. Not in the paper.
Bavli: [Megillah 32a:7](sefaria:Megillah.32a.7) (8 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Shefatya”. Amora citing R. Yoḥanan. Biblical (2 Sam 3:4). Not in the paper.

Bavli: [Avodah_Zarah 34b:9](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.34b.9) (16 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim”. Also Rav Elyakim, R. Yosei ben Elyakim. Biblical. The paper names 'Elyakim' only in English in the Bareket quote (L1486), not in the numbered list.
Bavli: [Berakhot 15b:27](sefaria:Berakhot.15b.27) (3 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Ovadya”. Amora before Rava. Biblical. Hebrew form עובדיה not in the paper.

Bavli: [Bava_Kamma 97a:1](sefaria:Bava_Kamma.97a.1) (9 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Daniel bar Ketina”. Amora (Rav Daniel bar Rav Ketina). Biblical. In the paper דניאל is only the biblical Daniel in a footnote list of biblical double names. [paper hits: L1813 fn12; L1818 fn12]
Bavli: [Berakhot 27b:7](sefaria:Berakhot.27b.7) (4 segments). Gazetteer: “Avidan”. Student of Rabbi; also 'Bei Avidan' ([Shabbat 152a](sefaria:Shabbat.152a)). Biblical (Num 1:11). Not in the paper.
Bavli: [Keritot 28b:2](sefaria:Keritot.28b.2) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “Elishama ben Pikai”. Late Second Temple priest. Biblical. Father's name פיכאי is unclear (Greek?) - uncertain.

Bavli: [Arakhin 16a:13](sefaria:Arakhin.16a.13) (22 segments). Gazetteer: “Sason”. Father of R. Anani and R. Inini bar Sason. Hebrew 'joy'. ענני itself is in the paper only in fn27 (L1870 'ענן מענני').
Bavli: [Avodah Zarah 17a:5](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.17a.5) (20 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Pedat”. 'דאמר רבי פדת'. Not in the paper. Hebrew פד״ה ‘redeem’.
Bavli: [Gittin 6b:6](sefaria:Gittin.6b.6) (4 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Evyatar”. 'שלח ליה רבי אביתר לרב חסדא'. Biblical name (Abiathar).
Bavli: [Berakhot 11a:19](sefaria:Berakhot.11a.19) (4 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Yeḥezkel”. 'תני רב יחזקאל'. Biblical name (Ezekiel).
Bavli: [Moed Katan 28a:17](sefaria:Moed_Katan.28a.17) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Seorim”. 'רב שעורים אחוה דרבא'. The word means ‘barley’.
